messages.author: 7e5aee507aac9c46
messages.subject: Shiny crashes on Linux!
parts:
Hello

This is my first post to this group.
We are trying out Shiny to develop an interactive web dashboard application. It works great on Windows and OSX, but when we try to run it on Linux (through R interactive shell) it crashes.

Our host is a 64bit VM running Ubuntu 13.10 (GNU/Linux 3.11.0-12-generic x86_64).
R version 3.1.0 (2014-04-10) -- "Spring Dance"

We know that it crashes on certain UI components. For instance, a ui.R with a single DateInput crashes the server as soon as the page is loaded in any browser.

I've attached a sample ui.R and server.R.

Please help!
Thank you,
Harold Ship
